descriptions.notStarted: I should go see Kay the engineer at the Omega Sector.
descriptions.inProgress: I met an engineer named Kay at the Omega Sector Silo. She said she'd been looking for an assistant, and asked if I could help her out. For my first task, since she's trying to develop a new machine that recycles MT-09's fuel, she wanted me to collect #b5 MT-09's Fuels#k.\n\n#t4000126# #b#c4000126##k/5
descriptions.completed: I went around and collected the fuel for MT-09. This was for Kay the Engineer, who was at the Silo of the Omega Sector. I wonder what kind of a machine Kay will make with the fuel...
